parole.testo: Uncertain, widespread in the Semitic language family, but considered all descendant of Ugaritic 𐎔𐎆𐎚 (pwt) through likely Akkadian, being considered itself a foreign loan and a hapax; controversially related to Hittite 𒊺𒉿𒁕 (ŠE.BE.DA /⁠puwattis⁠/, “color, paint, stain”). Compare Hebrew פּוּאָה (pūʾā),
